rules: Problem evidence comes before method selection. Tutorials may support implementation only.
Separate verified pain, vendor assertions, research evidence and our product hypothesis. Record inaccessible sources honestly.
Find current competing products and counterevidence; explain why a narrow user segment might still be underserved.
Allow research-only possibilities but label them exploratory, set auto_eligible=false and never recommend for automatic building.
A weekly release tests a customer decision or risky assumption; it is not an arbitrary ML exercise.
For thesis: additionally require feasible data, meaningful baselines, research question and closest-work review.
Keep broad source/domain exploration; the current three projects are not future topic filters.
Do not fill quotas with weak ideas. Report rejected candidates and missing evidence.
Read the complete discussion including accepted answer, final author response, closed/solved status and linked fixes before using a complaint as opportunity evidence.
Record original publication date separately from retrieval date. Search crawl freshness is not evidence of newness or trend.
Resolved reports and intentional documented behaviour are counterevidence. They cannot justify an unresolved-gap claim without independent current evidence of a remaining problem.
New/trending claims require dated corroborating signals across time and independent origins; otherwise explicitly say trend not assessed.

For every auto-eligible recommendation require full_thread_reviewed=true, resolution_status=unresolved, published_at, verified_at and remaining_gap on at least one problem source. These are reviewed facts, never guessed metadata.
P8 is withdrawn. P9 and P10 remain exploratory and cannot auto-start until a new reviewed version and review window are published. Do not substitute another recommendation to fill the slot.

Historical papers and tutorials may supply background, baselines or methods only. They cannot establish a current business opportunity by themselves. Record publication and revision dates separately from verification dates.

For a current opportunity, independently verify recent evidence that the customer problem persists and review present-day alternatives. Explain why now. Older unresolved needs are permitted with current corroboration; age alone is not a rejection rule.
For claims of emerging or trending opportunities, use recent dated independent signals and comparative activity over time. A single paper, repository or complaint does not establish a trend.
P10 is withdrawn, not merely downgraded. Do not republish without a newly sourced current problem and competitive review.
